First apply algebraMap_eq_iff_mul_eq_of_isIdempotentElem at (s e) with he.map s (or the equalizer-val version) to get s e * s a = s e * t a. Then run s(e*a) = s e * s a = s e * t a = t e * t a = t(e*a) using s e = t e. In exists_monic_lift_with_supported_equalities, a = p.coeff k, s and t are RingHoms, and hst is a hypothesis. The proposed lemma needs only s t : A →+* B, e idempotent, s e = t e, [IsLocalization.Away (s e) Be] and the localized equality. These are exactly what both sites already have. It uses only the earlier lemma in the same namespace, so there is no dependency cycle. The caller-specific part is the production of hlocal, which differs between the two proofs and stays in place. lemma IsLocalization.Away.map_mul_eq_map_mul_of_algebraMap_eq {A B Be : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing Be] [Algebra B Be] (s t : A →+* B) (e : A) (he : IsIdempotentElem e) (hst : s e = t e) [IsLocalization.Away (s e) Be] {a : A} (h : algebraMap B Be (s a) = algebraMap B Be (t a)) : s (e * a) = t (e * a)
-- proof: have hm := (algebraMap_eq_iff_mul_eq_of_isIdempotentElem (s e) (he.map s) _ _).mp h; calc s (e*a) = s e * s a := map_mul s _ _; _ = s e * t a := hm; _ = t e * t a := by rw [hst]; _ = t (e*a) := (map_mul t _ _).symm
